quests.LogDescription: 'Toss ingredients from the Basket of Root Vegetables, Barrel of Crabs, and Hearty Vrykul Grains into Havi\'s Stewpot.'
quests.QuestDescription:
'I could sense your power the moment you arrived in this land. You carry great purpose and a heavy task.

Know that the Aegis of Agrammar rests in the high halls of the All-Father. Only if you prove your valor, can you claim it against your foe.

Many trials must you face for this, but first I must know your strength. My stew is incomplete, and my old bones couldn't carry the ingredients up the hill. 

You look like you have a good arm. Will you help an old man finish his stew?'

'<As the raven stares into your eyes, an odd voice fills your mind.>

I know who you are, champion, and I know what you seek.

Come to me, if you think yourself truly worthy.'
